rationale: Selected all four catalogue components to directly address the task requirements. denial_code_ranking segments by denied_claims scope to isolate which codes dominate among actual denials; quantify_missing set to overall to account for the ~10% of claims lacking denial codes. denial_rate_by_segment uses the three segmentation dimensions explicitly named in the task objective (place_of_service, auth_required_flag, network_status); min_group_size=30 flags small groups as indicated by task tags. write_report includes synthetic_data and descriptive_only caveats appropriate to this synthetic denials analysis; show_denominators and cite_artifacts enabled for statistical discipline and reproducibility.
